messages:
Nina Chen: Sharing a short 'Activation roundtrip' playbook draft — focused on client handshake, cache warm paths, batching hints, and lightweight feedback capture tied to renewal signals. Link: https://redwood.link/activation-roundtrip-playbook

Ravi Patel: looks good. quick q — for renewal-risk signals do we recommend sampling actual user prompts + latencies or prefer synthetic probes to avoid PII exposure?

Nina Chen: prefer probes + stratified telemetry. probes catch perf regressions without text. for any sampled user traffic we only surface hashed prompt ids, token_count, latency_ms, and model_variant (no raw text). added that note in section 2.

Marta Gomez: i'll add a short enablement snippet customers can drop in. suggestion: client-side prefill + small batch window for non-interactive flows. e.g.
```
// prefill + batch example
client.prefill('/session/start')
client.configure({ batchWindowMs: 50, streamingFallback: true })
```
Also call out: streaming = default for interactive sessions.

Evan Li: ops note — include a lightweight /health/activation probe that warms KV cache and returns model_variant + kv_hit_rate. sample response we use internally: {"model":"redwood-lite","kv_hit":0.85,"latency_ms":120} 
Also recommend exposing probe-run-id so we can correlate with CS telemetry.

OnboardBot: ✅ Checklist updated: 'Activation roundtrip smoke' -> run 3 probes from customer region, capture latency_ms, kv_hit_rate, model_variant; ensure metrics sent to cs.telemetry and assigned to customer workspace.

Ravi Patel: for the renewals checklist i'd add a 'surge readiness' checkbox: prewarm_tokens configured, batchWindow <= 100ms for bulk flows, streamingFallback enabled, and a documented rollback policy. i'll draft the one-pager for PMs.

Nina Chen: perfect — can someone do a language pass on privacy/consent bits? want it clear and customer-friendly before i merge. thanks! :thumbsup:
